brand_identity.name: SK Sweets Food Court
brand_identity.vibe: Luxury Heritage, Timeless, Trustworthy, Authentic, Premium, Elegant
anti_patterns: Cheap shadows or overly soft UI without structure
Stock imagery or CSS photo filters

rules: Never use default generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, Playfair, or Space Grotesk.
Overlines must be Manrope, uppercase, widely tracked, and muted copper.
Headings must use Cormorant Garamond to establish traditional heritage luxury.
Line height for headings must be tight (leading-none or leading-[1.1]). Line height for body must be loose (leading-relaxed).
Backgrounds must strictly alternate between Cream and Ivory. No pure white backgrounds for large sections to avoid a sterile look.
Burgundy is for primary CTAs and major accent moments. Do not overuse.
Dark Charcoal must be used for all primary text for readability, never pure black.
Do NOT use gradients on text or backgrounds. Stick to solid luxury tones.
Use 'light' or 'regular' weight Phosphor icons to maintain a premium outlined look.
Never use bold, duotone, or filled icons unless for specific brand logos like WhatsApp.
MANDATORY: Use ONLY the provided real photographs. NO stock images.
NO CSS photo filters. Do not alter photographs with grayscale, sepia, or artificial tinting.
Permitted image treatments: object-cover, border-radius (20px), lazy loading.
Hover effect: Subtle zoom only (scale-105 transition-transform duration-700 ease-out).
Image overlays: For text legibility over hero images, use max bg-black/20 or a targeted gradient. Never completely dim the image.

hero_background.description: Interior wide shot with khakhra aisle, chandelier, product shelves.

brand_story_split.description: SK Sweets marble/gold logo wall installation.

signature_sweets_1.description: Sweet counter — pedas, barfis, mewa bites.

navigation.desktop: Sticky nav. Initially transparent over hero (text-white). On scroll, transitions to glass_header (text-charcoal).
navigation.mobile_drawer: Premium side drawer. Ivory background, huge Cormorant Garamond links, muted copper dividers.

buttons.primary: bg-burgundy_deep text-white hover:bg-burgundy_muted rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-colors duration-300 font-medium tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-burgundy_deep text-burgundy_deep hover:bg-burgundy_deep hover:text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-colors duration-300 font-medium
buttons.whatsapp: bg-utility-whatsapp_green text-white hover:bg-green-600 rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-medium
buttons.swiggy: bg-utility-swiggy_orange text-white hover:bg-orange-600 rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-medium

product_card.layout: Image top (rounded-t-[20px] or inner 16px radius if padded), content bottom. Border border-ivory, bg-white.
product_card.image_container: overflow-hidden. Image must scale-105 on group-hover.
product_card.content: p-6. Title in Cormorant Garamond (text-2xl). Subtitle in Manrope. No prices! WhatsApp CTA button.

catalogue.filters: Pill-shaped toggle buttons. Active: bg-burgundy_deep text-white. Inactive: bg-ivory text-charcoal hover:bg-cream border border-gold_light/30.
catalogue.search: Minimalist input field, bottom-border only or very subtle rounded full, using Phosphor MagnifyingGlass.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use generous padding: py-24 or py-32 for major sections.
homepage_flow: Hero (Full screen height min-h-[90vh], interior background, centered typography, clear CTAs)
Brand Story (Split screen: Left Text, Right Logo Wall Image, highly asymmetrical)
Signature Specialties (Bento/Tetris grid of top 2-3 images, large luxury cards)
Product Categories (4-column grid on desktop, 1-column on mobile. Highly visual)
Product Catalogue (Searchable, filterable masonry or strict grid. NO PRICES)
Fast Food & Celebration Orders (Full-width distinct sections with ivory background to break layout)
Gallery Preview (Horizontal scroll or masonry of 4-5 images)
Reviews (Curated text-based elegant cards, ivory bg)
Visit Us / Footer (Map, hours, deep burgundy background for footer)

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on all buttons. 700ms ease-out zoom on images. Staggered fade-up for grid items.
motion.page_load: Subtle fade-in for hero text. No excessive bounces or spring animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic Shadcn components for marketing sections; build custom HTML/Tailwind elements for layouts to allow exact asymmetrical spacing.
Implement Shadcn for functional parts ONLY: Dialog (for gallery lightbox), Tabs (for catalogue filtering), Input (for search).
NO PRICES should be displayed anywhere in the catalogue or cards. It is an inquiry/WhatsApp order-focused catalogue.
Configure Tailwind with the exact color hex codes provided in this JSON.
Ensure the transparent-to-solid navigation transition works seamlessly on scroll.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Missing categories = use provided placeholders or structure gracefully. NEVER use text placeholders for images.
